prompt: Read-only health check. Inspect current Kolibri services, disk, memory, VPN reachability, Mimo version, and recent service errors. Do not edit files, restart services, change firewall rules, install packages, or reveal secrets. Return a concise structured report with blockers and recommended next actions.

quality_contract.objective: Establish whether the selected Kolibri server is safe to receive read-only Mimo agent work.
quality_contract.context: This is the first health gate before any continuous agent rollout or controlled mutation task.
scope: Inspect system health, Kolibri service status, VPN reachability, disk, memory, and Mimo availability.
Use read-only commands only and report exact evidence for every blocker.
Treat missing tools, missing worktree, or unhealthy services as risks rather than fixing them.
out_of_scope: Do not edit files, install packages, restart services, reboot, or change firewall rules.
Do not read secrets, auth files, .env files, .ssh, or .mimocode.
Do not start long-running agents or background processes.
acceptance_criteria: Report online/offline status, disk free space, RAM pressure, Mimo path/version, and Kolibri service state.
Identify whether this server is ready for a read-only pilot task.
List blockers with concrete remediation recommendations for Codex review.
verification_steps: Check basic OS, disk, memory, and process/service status.
Check Mimo version without exposing auth configuration.
Check recent Kolibri service errors without dumping secrets.
deliverables: Structured result with status, summary, changed_files, checks, risks, and artifacts.
Readiness decision: ready, degraded, or blocked.
stop_conditions: Stop if a command requires reading credentials, tokens, private keys, or auth files.
Stop if the investigation requires modifying server state.
